registry.display_name: Balanced COPA (Kavumba et al., ACL 2019; extends Roemmele et al., 2011)
registry.rationale: Organic real-world English causal commonsense (cause/effect) with mirrored counterfactual premises that expose superficial lexical shortcuts; clean CC-BY-4.0 license; pure CSV readable by Python stdlib with zero external dependencies.
registry.source_disjoint_unit: choice_pair_cluster (keeps original + mirrored counterfactual pairs strictly in same split; official test.csv has 0 choice-pair overlap with train.csv)

registry.display_name: SQuAD 2.0 Development Set (Rajpurkar, Jia & Liang, ACL 2018)
registry.rationale: Real-world unstructured Wikipedia prose with exact character-offset gold evidence spans AND ~50% human-authored unanswerable questions (is_impossible=True), enabling real evidence grounding, cross-topic transfer, and non-synthetic abstention measurement. Because license is CC-BY-SA-4.0, raw text is NEVER committed into the Apache-2.0 repo.
registry.source_disjoint_unit: wikipedia_article_title (35 distinct topic domains partitioned 14 train / 7 val / 14 hidden_eval with 0 shared articles)

optional_full_haystack_file.name: longmemeval_s_cleaned.json
optional_full_haystack_file.note: Full 277 MB ~40-session haystack audited & pinned for optional offline heavy runs; S11.0 CI uses 15.4 MB oracle file with split-internal K=10 chronological distractor-session augmentation.

registry.rationale: Real multi-session conversational memory benchmark (500 episodes, 6 memory categories: single-session user/assistant/preference, multi-session, temporal-reasoning, knowledge-update) with session/turn gold evidence grounding (answer_session_ids + has_answer) and 30 genuine unanswerable abstention questions (*_abs). Permissive MIT license.
registry.source_disjoint_unit: connected_component_over_shared_haystack_session_ids (resolves 8 cross-question shared sessions among 940 unique sessions; zero session-ID overlap across splits)
registry.verified_license: MIT (verified on both GitHub SPDX and Hugging Face dataset card)

registry.rationale: Clean Apache-2.0 license (also manifest-pinned in PR #43), but templated/controlled synthetic English — does not test organic open-world language. Deferred as secondary controlled-deduction diagnostic in S11.1+.

registry.display_name: bAbI QA (Weston et al., Facebook AI Research)
registry.rationale: Permissive CC-BY-3.0, already used as a narrow parser probe in five-organ external eval, but purely synthetic templated stories. Not sufficient as an open-world benchmark.
Valid real-world Wikipedia QA under CC-BY-SA-3.0, but HF release uses Parquet only and lacks sentence-offset evidence spans and explicit unanswerable abstention questions compared to SQuAD 2.0.

registry.display_name: AI2 ARC Easy & Challenge (Clark et al., 2018 — allenai/ai2_arc)
registry.rationale: Strong real-world science commonsense benchmark under CC-BY-SA-4.0; lacks passage evidence spans in the core split and uses HF Parquet. Reserved for S11.2+ world-knowledge transfer once a verified corpus-learning loop exists.

High-value multi-hop evidence grounding benchmark, but primary CMU JSON host returned DNS resolution failure (Errno 11001) during audit and HF mirror is Parquet-only. Deferred to S11.1+ once pinned JSON mirror or optional parquet reader is approved.
HF card declares MIT, but upstream GitHub repo has no SPDX license file and questions derive from ConceptNet (CC-BY-SA-4.0). Deferred in favor of cleaner CC-BY-4.0 Balanced COPA.
